Title: Add regression coverage for the local-profile wiki-search flow and inline source references.
Description: Add focused tests for the exact sequence exercised on the live page: Agent mode, local profile, a generic wiki-search request, context preloading, and inline source-reference output. The regression should prove the turn produces either a final answer or a deterministic tool path, and it should fail if the turn remains pending beyond the expected window. Acceptance criteria: the test covers the local profile path, the trace contains the expected preload/tool events, and the result includes a source reference or explicit fallback. Validation: run the new test and confirm it passes against the local app.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: the app already exposes context-planner and preload events in the trace, but the live turn still stalled before completion, so this needs a deterministic regression around the exact probe flow.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Completed by adding `MemoryChatAgent_AgentModeLocalWikiSearchFlowStreamsPreloadAndInlineSourceReference` in `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs`. The regression exercises Agent mode with a local-model-style JSON tool-call path, asserts context-planner preload/tool trace events, and verifies inline source references render into clickable memory links through `ChatReferenceLinkPolicy`. Focused validation passed via `dotnet test .\MemorySmith.Tests\MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~MemoryChatAgent_AgentModeLocalWikiSearchFlowStreamsPreloadAndInlineSourceReference|Name~MemoryChatAgent_StreamsToolCallStatusWithoutLeakingToolJson|Name~ChatReferenceLinkPolicy_LinkifiesInlineCodeSourceReferences|Name~MemoryChatAgent_StreamTraceShowsContextPlannerSkipReason" --logger "console;verbosity=minimal"` (4/4).
